Messages.Author: John Wade Kim
Messages.Body:
Hmm, here is a couple of deck ideas i have....
1st is a tremere celerity deck. The top 4 tremere all have celerity, and it really hurts for someone to strike theft of vitae, blur and use 2 blood furies.
I made this deck and it works well, plus it is easy to press if you are using celerity

2nd I have a Nosferatu/ gangrel deck(mostly 9 and 10 vampires) and I use potence, Fortitude, Animalism, and a bit of ofuscate... I play cards like drawing out the beast and immortal grapple(must strike hands, no dodges or majasty) and I use alot of melee weapons and potence and do lots of damage(sengir dagger is the best) and send them to torpor with stakes and agravated. I soak all the damage the other vampires do with fortitude, and If someone plays a big weapon deck I have Storm sewers to make it close
range, and i use Canine hoards to destroy their equip. It a fun deck cause you bring out 2 vampires and with animalism and 4 wakes, you can block several minions with your 2.

3rd This is a boring one to play, but I don't lose with it(won a torniment sunday with it) Venture Fame/day operation/bleed/freak drive...It's sick and disgusting

well that's just some ideas to work with
wave
scy...@alpha2.csd.uwm.edu

Messages.Author: Erwan Cario
Messages.Body:
Some other good ideas with Tremere:

Tremere with Fortitude.
I play with it and it's quite nice too.
It's very efficient against Gangrel or all other "Fighting Deck".The three older Tremeres have fortitude (superior for Cardano). You can press with Indomitability and it prevent one damage.
I put 6 master cards Fortitude in my 70 card deck.

Try Burst Of Sunlight with Fame and the Chantry. It's very funny when your prey have less than 3 pool...

When you play with Fortitude against a Fortitude deck, take 8 or 9 Blood Fury and some Dawn Operation.

Salut.

Erwan Cario
eca...@irisa.fr

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
eca...@irisa.fr (Erwan Cario) writes:

>Is it possible for a methuselah to spent The Edge for a vote during a bloodhunt vote?

Sure. The only restrictions are on Action Mods and Reaction cards. Those
cards are restricted because there is no action to Modify nor React to.
